news_format.title: NEW Stuff!
news_format.text: New projects and tweaks land here when there's something to say.

about.text: Hello!  I'm a (mostly former) professional SW dev with experience in everyhting from C++ to writing javascript apps.  I had mostly retired from it, but using Grok (Bot) as an assistant, I've started developing again.  The following creations are designed by me & grok (90/10) and implententd by me & grok (10/90).

projects.name: Bio Tank
projects.text: Behaviors over hardcoding. Bubbles merge, munchers almost flock, meat eaters keep the tank self-regulating. Emergent and pretty — hit tab for debug stats.

projects.name: All We Are Is Grok in the Wind
projects.text: Custom white-noise machine: sixteen band-pass channels, per-band gain and slow LFOs. My windy background for days — randomize, tweak, save to JSON.

projects.name: Geocentric Heliocentric with Orbit Trails
projects.text: Geocentric vs heliocentric with dynamic orbit trails. Started from a one-line Grok prompt — solar_system_earth_to_sun — and grew from there.

projects.name: War of the Planetoids
projects.text: Arcade duel that's been on my mind for years. Circles became shapes, an AI opponent kept pace, and the sound is all HTML5 audio.
